history.content: i have a stomach pain and feel like vomiting

Stomach pain with nausea/vomiting can be caused by many things like food poisoning, infections, gastritis, or other conditions. For now, avoid solid foods until vomiting stops for at least 6 hours, then slowly return to a normal diet, and drink small amounts of clear fluids to stay hydrated. Seek immediate medical help if you have sudden sharp pain, vomiting blood, black tarry stools, a stiff/hard abdomen, or pain radiating to your chest, neck, or shoulder. Please consult a healthcare professional.
